title: sieve: RFC 5229 variables extension
description: Implement RFC 5229 Sieve Variables extension in crates/sieve/src/extensions/variables.rs. Activated by require 'variables'. New action: set [:modifier] <name> <value> — stores named variable. Variable expansion: ${name} in string arguments is replaced with stored value. Modifiers: :lower (lowercase), :upper (uppercase), :length (replace with string length as decimal), :quotewildcard (escape * and ? for use in :matches). Capture variables: after a :matches test succeeds, ${0} = full match, ${1}..${n} = wildcard capture groups in order. Variable names are case-insensitive. Undefined variables expand to empty string. Extend MessageContext evaluation to thread a VariableScope (HashMap<String, String>) through the evaluation pass. Tests: set and expand variable, modifier :lower/:upper/:length/:quotewildcard, capture groups from :matches wildcard, undefined variable expands to empty, case-insensitive name. Oracle: RFC 5229 §5 examples.
